text.index.ts: Finds the terminal of a Claude session from its id without touching it, through its tmux pane when it runs in tmux, so a card can ask before offering the jump; brings that terminal forward with the integration for its app, or just opens the app when it has none.
text.index.ts gotcha: A terminal in an editor resolves to the editor, but one of the embedded editor resolves to no app.
text.shell.ts: Runs a command with a timeout that gives null on failure, quotes text for AppleScript, lists the processes on a tty and writes a window title to a tty.
text.shell.ts gotcha: The title goes to the tty directly, past tmux, so only the terminal that owns the tty sees it.
text.index.ts < src/main/proctree.ts#parsePsT: reads the process table to climb from a tty to its app
text.index.ts = src/main/session-files.ts#rea: finds the process id of the session by its id
text.index.ts = src/main/session-jump/integra: reads which tty shows the session's pane
